# 為什麼製作這個整合包？
這個整合包的存在只有一個簡單的原因：我熱愛原版 Minecraft，但我從來沒有真正喜歡過其他「類原版」風格的整合包。總覺得哪裡怪怪的。所以我決定自己做一個。
本整合包專為追求純正 Minecraft 體驗的玩家打造，在保留原版精髓的同時，僅做恰到好處的優化，讓遊戲流程更流暢、畫面更清爽、遊玩體驗更佳。
本整合包設計目標
- 保持玩法忠於原版
- 僅加入輕微的便利性（QoL）改良
- 維持單人與多人模式的完美平衡
- 提供穩定且輕量化的基礎，適合長期經營世界
您可期待以下內容
- 效能與優化調整，帶來更流暢的遊玩體驗
- 貼合 Minecraft 原有風格的微幅視覺與易用性升級

# 主要模組列表
<details>
<summary>效能優化模組</summary>

- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)
- [Entity View Distance](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-view-distance)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [NoisiumForked](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisiumforked)
- [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux) (Startlight fork)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)

</details>

<details>
<summary>視覺模組</summary>

- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)
- [Better Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds)
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)
- [Explosive Enhancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement)
- [Inventory Particles](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles)
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights)
- [Particle Effects](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-effects)
- [Particle Interactions](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-interactions)
- [Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-shadowy-path-blocks)
- 其他模組與資源包

</details>

<details>
<summary>便利性模組</summary>

- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)
- [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements)
- [Better Mount HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-mount-hud)
- [Better Statistics Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats)
- [Better Than Mending](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-than-mending)
- [BetterF3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3)
- [Boat Item View](https://modrinth.com/mod/boat-item-view)
- [Bookshelf Inspector](https://modrinth.com/mod/bookshelf-inspector)
- [Cherished Worlds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cherished-worlds)
- [Cut Through](https://modrinth.com/mod/cut-through)
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam)
- [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [Lighty](https://modrinth.com/mod/lighty)
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks)
- [Status Effect Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/status-effect-bars)
- [Veinminer](https://modrinth.com/mod/veinminer)
- [Villager Cycle](https://modrinth.com/mod/villagercycle)
- [Villager Trading Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/trading+)
- [Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify) (支援手把)

</details>

<details>
<summary>個人風格與特色</summary>

視覺模組與資源包，例如 [Explosive Enhancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement)，或是些趣味模組如 [Sit](https://modrinth.com/mod/bl4cks-sit) 或 [Customizable Player Models](https://modrinth.com/plugin/custom-player-models)
</details>

不建議嘗試在原版伺服器上遊玩，因為部分便利性功能可能被視為作弊。
我無法對您的帳號在伺服器被封禁承擔任何責任！

_上述列出的部分模組可能尚未更新至最新版本，因為新版本的 Minecraft 釋出後，模組作者需要時間進行更新。_
